📖 How to use

  1. Add each medication with its daily dose time.
  2. The list shows a live countdown to every next dose.
  3. Press Taken when you take it, or delete old entries.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Does this remind me if the tab is closed?

No — countdowns only run while the page is open. Keep the tab open or use your phone alarm for critical medication.

What happens after I press Taken?

The dose is marked with a timestamp and the countdown moves to the next scheduled time (tomorrow if today's time passed).

Is my medication list private?

Yes. It is stored only in this browser's local storage and never sent anywhere.
